# Avinash Gosavi

> Staff Software Engineer at Cisco Meraki in the San Francisco Bay Area. Writes about memory for AI agents (privacy-preserving, brain-inspired retrieval), plain-language summaries of research papers, distributed systems and API design, Ruby on Rails, and local-first AI. Builds open-source tools such as VaultMem (zero-knowledge encrypted memory for AI agents) and Attractor (Hopfield-inspired memory engine).

Full text of every post in one file: {{ "/llms-full.txt" | absolute_url }}

Every post is also available as plain Markdown: add `.md` to its URL in place of the trailing slash (e.g. {{ "/post/agent-memory-glossary.md" | absolute_url }}).

## Start here

- [Paper TL;DR: Six Papers That Shaped How I Think About AI Memory]({{ "/post/paper-tldr-six-papers-on-memory/" | absolute_url }}): overview of the core papers behind agent memory, each in plain language
- [An Agent Memory Glossary]({{ "/post/agent-memory-glossary/" | absolute_url }}): agent-memory terms defined simply
- [Research & Interests]({{ "/research/" | absolute_url }}): topics, papershelf with TL;DRs, newsletters
- [Projects]({{ "/projects/" | absolute_url }}): open-source projects with code and demos
- [About]({{ "/about/" | absolute_url }}): who Avinash is
